_comment: MIMO azimuth crossing — two OFF-boresight targets crossing in the x-y plane. A: (3,-2) moving (vx=1,vy=1); B: (7,2) moving (vx=-1,vy=-1). They meet at (5,0) around frame 40 (t=2s at 20 Hz), so their BEARINGS cross (A: -34deg -> +16deg through 0; B: +16deg -> -34deg through 0) and so do their y-coordinates — a genuine 2-D crossing, unlike scenario_mimo_crossing (boresight, collapses to y=0). The 2-D positions require the DoA/angle stage (the MIMO point). At the meeting point they share (x,y) but have OPPOSITE radial velocity (+1 vs -1 m/s), so they fall in different Doppler cells and stay resolvable with n_sources=1 (no unresolved merge). Tests the 2-D tracker's multi-target ID continuity through an angular crossing.
